issues.title: Receiver of Taxes Vacancy - Appointment or Referendum Under Discussion
issues.status_label: Active - board weighing appointment vs. referendum; October meeting scheduled
issues.description: Erica Winter, elected Town Receiver of Taxes in November 2025, stepped down after less than a year. Deputy Receiver Darlene Paolericio assumed her duties and continues to fulfill them. The Town Board made no appointment at its September 14, 2026 meeting and is weighing whether to appoint a replacement or hold a public referendum to make the position permanently appointed rather than elected; full discussion is scheduled for the October 2026 meeting.
